fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (NASDAQ:WMT) is the world's largest retailer by scale with a market cap of approximately $1 trillion and 10,900 stores across 190 countries, but the stock is trading at excessive valuations versus the 5-year average.
fields.summary_ko.1: The recent stock price is around $126 but trading at 38x P/E (5-year average 27x) and 1.37x P/S (5-year average 0.85x); current purchase is not recommended and a more reasonable price level is expected.
